Gunslinger: +1 For a successful Charisma check or save +1 For a successful Dexterity check or save +1 For landing a hit with a pistol weapon +1 For landing a hit with a grenade (stacks) +2 For killing an opponent with a pistol or grenade
Psycho: +1 For a successful Charisma check or save +1 For a successful Strength check or save +1 For landing a hit with a melee weapon +1 For landing a hit with a chemical weapon(stacks) +2 For killing an opponent with a melee or chemical weapon
Hacker: +1 For a successful Intelligence check or save +1 For a successful Dexterity check or save +1 For successfully hacking or bypassing an electronic security system +1 For successfully disabling, repairing, or modifying a technological device +1 For landing a hit with an electronic or energy weapon +2 For successfully taking control of a hostile electronic system or robotic enemy
Medic: +1 For a successful Intelligence check or save +1 For a successful Constitution check or save +1 For successfully diagnosing or treating an injury, illness, or biological condition +1 For successfully administering a drug, poison, or biological treatment to another creature +1 For successfully extracting useful biological information or material from a living organism +2 For successfully saving a creature at less than 10% their base hp by raising their hp above 50% or incapacitating an enemy through a biological effect
Soldier: +1 For a successful Strength check or save +1 For a successful Wisdom check or save +1 For successfully assisting an ally with a check +1 For landing a hit with a rifle or heavy weapon +1 For successfully identifying or exploiting a tactical advantage +2 For defeating an enemy through a coordinated attack involving at least one ally
Prophet: +1 For a successful Dexterity check or save +1 For a successful Wisdom check or save +1 For successfully identifying a hidden enemy, trap, or important detail through observation +1 For landing an attack with a precision or scoped weapon +1 For successfully persuading, inspiring, or intimidating another creature through religious conviction +2 For eliminating a dangerous enemy with a single carefully aimed shot
